hero.label: Revenue Intelligence · Discovery · Action
hero.headline: Discover where your business is losing revenue.
hero.description: ARQON analyzes your operational and financial data to identify revenue leaks, prioritize the biggest impacts, and show where your business should act first.
problem.label: The problem
problem.headline: Revenue doesn't disappear all at once.
problem.description: It hides in small signals scattered across the company's systems.
problem.cards.money.title: Stalled money
problem.cards.money.text: Overdue invoices and receipts that miss the deadline.
problem.cards.clients.title: Forgotten clients
problem.cards.clients.text: Customers who stop buying or disappear from the commercial radar.
problem.cards.opportunities.title: Lost opportunities
problem.cards.opportunities.text: Deals that remain stagnant until they lose relevance.
problem.cards.contracts.title: Contracts at risk
problem.cards.contracts.text: Renewals approaching without adequate commercial action.

whatYouGet.label: What you get
whatYouGet.headline: Don't just deliver data. Deliver decisions.

whatYouGet.benefits.visibility.text: Know exactly where revenue loss signals exist.
whatYouGet.benefits.prioritization.title: Prioritization
whatYouGet.benefits.prioritization.text: Discover which problems deserve attention first by potential impact.
whatYouGet.benefits.action.title: Action
whatYouGet.benefits.action.text: Turn every finding into a practical recommendation.
differentiator.label: ARQON differentiator
differentiator.headline: Your business already has the data. ARQON finds what's hidden in it.
differentiator.description: ARQON is not an ERP, not a CRM, not generic BI. It's a revenue operational intelligence layer that traverses your existing data to find financial opportunities and leaks that go unnoticed in traditional dashboards.
